text: 伯恩斯坦分析师指出，第三季度初期数据显示中国奢侈品消费明显放缓，令该板块的复苏再度面临“昙花一现”的风险。来自奢侈品购物中心的销售数据显示，6月及7月各价位及品类的消费均大幅走弱，7月份更录得同比下滑12%。今年第一季度整体增长基本持平，第二季度则仅录得低个位数增长。 此次放缓打断了过去四个季度逐步复苏的态势。分析指，消费者信心在疫情后持续低迷，加之奢侈品牌在疫后消费热潮期间大幅提价，令中产阶层购买力承压；当局加强对境外资产的审查，以及更严格税务执法的预期，似乎正在抑制高净值人士的消费意愿。 受上述趋势走弱影响，第三季度行业有机增长预测被下调110个基点
text_en: Bernstein analysts noted that early third-quarter data shows a significant slowdown in Chinese luxury consumption, putting the sector's recovery at renewed risk of being 'short-lived.' Sales data from luxury shopping malls show consumption weakened substantially across price points and categories in June and July, with July recording a 12% year-on-year decline. Overall growth in the first quarter was roughly flat, while the second quarter saw only low single-digit growth. This slowdown interrupts the gradual recovery seen over the past four quarters. Analysts said consumer confidence has remained weak since the pandemic, and hefty price increases by luxury brands during the post-pandemic spending boom have squeezed middle-class purchasing power; authorities' heightened scrutiny of overseas assets and expectations of stricter tax enforcement appear to be curbing high-net-worth individuals' spending intentions. Due to these weakening trends, third-quarter industry organic growth forecasts were cut by 110 basis points.
